gold_note: Pachycephalosaur strict consensus, panel A. The node circles '1&2' and '3' are keys to a legend printed in the figure (1 Pachycephalosauria, 2 Pachycephalosauridae, 3 Pachycephalosaurinae), so, as with caption keys, they are not encoded. Polytomies: a four-way node (Wannanosaurus, Colepiocephale, Stegoceras, Pachycephalosaurinae), a ten-way pachycephalosaurine node and a three-way node whose stem enters at Sphaerotholus goodwini's height. 18 tips, 3 polytomies (4, 10, 3 children). Random-sample case (seed 20261122). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
